note: The kinds of skill (plan.md 14-30, 14-31; the person, 2026-11-09). A skill is source code a model takes when it needs it. The list is open: a new kind is one entry here, landed by the design seat on the person's word (meta_agent/tasks/011 adds scale and capability). side_effects are the ones a skill of the kind may declare; none touches no device, read_device reads one, write_device changes its state. A device is reached only through the tools a skill names (calls_tools), never from the skill's own code. estimate and diagnostic added on the person's word of 2026-11-17 (docs/ideas/20261117.md, tasks/016).

bound.what: computes a maximum, a minimum or a value of one parameter from one physical, numerical or instrument reason

data_analysis.what: turns data it is handed into computed numbers with their basis

estimate.what: gives a setup value or the cost of a run or a measurement from a relation and the quantities it is handed (a box for a volume fraction, the scans a signal needs, a run's duration); not a limit, which is a bound; it may give the quantities one relation ties together

diagnostic.what: judges the state of a run or a measurement from data it is handed (settled, equilibrated, a trend), by a criterion it is handed as an input; it holds no criterion of its own, and without one it says undecided, since a criterion is the person's

hardware_connection.what: finds what answers, reads its identity, opens and closes a session; writes no setting

hardware_state.what: reads what state a device is in and says ready, busy, fault or unknown by a rule in the skill

hardware_boot.what: the ordered steps that bring a device from off to ready, each verified, a person's steps waited for

hardware_control.what: a procedure of gated tool calls that changes a device's state

hardware_calibration.what: reads whether the device calibrates the quantity itself; self: the device's routine as gated tool calls; assisted: a calibration design drafted with the person; unknown: a gap

hardware_range.what: reads what the device reports about its own ranges and modes (the person, 2026-11-09: the agent finds the instrument's operable range itself; meta_agent/tasks/014)
